top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. top.title: Classiq Introduces Fault Tolerance Engine to Bridge Quantum Applications and Fault-Tolerant Hardware
top.summary: Classiq launched its Fault Tolerance Engine, a new capability that translates optimized logical quantum programs into fault-tolerant execution plans and measures physical resources and reliability needed for execution on fault-tolerant quantum computers. The engine addresses the fundamental software challenge of fault-tolerant quantum computing by handling qubit layout, routing, scheduling, and error correction cycles, enabling developers to assess physical feasibility before implementation.

top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

top.title: Bone Metastasis in Solid Tumors Market Insights, Epidemiology, and 7MM Forecast - 2036 | Precision Oncology and Radiopharmaceuticals Unlock New Growth Opportunities
top.summary: The bone metastasis in solid tumors market is expected to expand from 2026-2036 across seven major markets, driven by rising cancer survival rates, improved diagnostics, and growing demand for targeted therapies and radiopharmaceuticals. The market is characterized by established treatments like denosumab and zoledronic acid, with emerging therapies including cabozantinib and radioligand treatments. Key unmet needs include limited disease-modifying therapies, persistent skeletal complications, and lack of validated biomarkers for treatment selection.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.0 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.0 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Pasqal Appoints Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer
top.summary: Pasqal, a neutral-atom quantum computing company, announced the appointment of Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer. Lao brings nearly 20 years of international legal experience, including expertise in corporate governance, capital markets, and M&A. She previously served as General Counsel at Deezer and held senior legal roles at Adisseo and SMCP. Her appointment supports Pasqal's expansion as a publicly traded company and global scaling efforts.

top.title: BREAKING: Pasqal Holding Investigated for Securities Fraud by Block & Leviton LLP; Investors Should Contact the Firm to Learn More
top.summary: Block & Leviton is investigating Pasqal Holding for potential securities law violations, alleging the company misled investors about its role in a French defense quantum-computing program. Pasqal announced on September 28, 2026, that it was ending participation in LSQUARE/PROQCIMA after the first phase, describing it as an 'evolution,' but the company had not previously disclosed the program's outcome. Following the announcement, Pasqal's stock fell approximately 7.4%. The investigation focuses on whether leadership knew about the program's end earlier and failed to disclose it to investors.

top.title: uniQure Plunges on Additional Data From Huntington's Disease Study
top.summary: uniQure (QURE) announced mixed phase I/II data for its investigational gene therapy ifezuntirgene inilparvovec for Huntington's disease treatment. At 36 months, the therapy showed 80% slowing in cUHDRS and 67% in TFC versus external controls. However, 48-month data showed weaker results with cUHDRS at 44% slowing (not statistically significant) and TFC at 61% slowing. The stock plunged 37% following the announcement. The company has submitted a BLA to the FDA based on 36-month data, with regulatory review and durability validation as key upcoming catalysts.

top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

top.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
top.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.
